decisionScope: domestic MVP product defaults; Hy-MT2 is the server-side translation main route

default.reason: iPhone CoreML path is verified in app and passes the default smoke fixture for Chinese, English and code-switching.

gray.reason: Beelink smoke output was accurate with 663 ms latency; keep runtime/checkpoint compatibility patch explicit before wider rollout.

fallback.reason: Accurate on smoke audio but Transformers path measured 7259 ms, so it is not the realtime default until vLLM or streaming backend is proven.

default.reason: Beelink product-fit evaluation passed 12/12 cases with P50 152 ms and P95 303 ms, so use Hy-MT2 as the domestic server-side translation main model. The 3424 MB max torch VRAM result is retained only as capacity-planning evidence, not a release gate.

gray.reason: Keep Qwen as a quality fallback for difficult context, summaries and AI Agent text tasks, but not as the main release blocker.

fallback.reason: LMT-60-0.6B stays as a low-cost fallback only after segmentation and de-duplication, because mixed-language input is weaker than Hy-MT2.

default.reason: System TTS bridge is verified and is safest for MVP on-device playback.

gray.reason: Beelink product-fit testing shows audio chunks with 22-32 ms first audio and 0.191-0.193 RTF. Translation Worker now has the VoxCPM2 HTTP TTS identity contract, and the Beelink Tailscale HTTP service passes check:tts-provider. Keep it gated until LiveKit/PSTN playback, concurrency, phone-band, and production HTTPS checks pass.

fallback.reason: Android system TTS remains the practical fallback for cross-platform MVP playback.

crossPlatformCall.tts: voxcpm2/VoxCPM2 main call TTS contract with system TTS captions fallback; qwen3_tts_candidate remains baseline
crossPlatformCall.releasePolicy: gray rollout only; keep VoxCPM2 worker/playback/concurrency/phone-band gates, CosyVoice2 intelligibility/runtime, and FireRed runtime caveats visible

evidence.cosyVoice2RuntimeIssue: Current venv cannot use the official torchaudio/torchcodec/FFmpeg path; prompt/reference/text_frontend/stream variants all failed ASR-proxy intelligibility.

notes: Hy-MT2-1.8B, Qwen3-ASR, FireRedASR2-AED, LMT-60-0.6B, Qwen3-TTS and CosyVoice2 model cards list Apache-2.0 licenses as of this review.
Default MVP route minimizes server GPU cost by keeping ASR/TTS on device where possible.
Server-side call translation now uses Hy-MT2-1.8B as the main self-hosted model and requires Beelink or equivalent GPU capacity plus real PSTN/VoIP media integration before paid release.

Server-side TTS is not fully production-ready yet: VoxCPM2 now has a Beelink Tailscale HTTP service and Worker provider identity checks, but still needs LiveKit/PSTN playback, concurrency, phone-band, production HTTPS, and text-normalization gates before release.

deferredCandidates.reason: Official runtime generated 24 kHz streaming audio with good first-audio latency, but baseline ASR-proxy intelligibility passed 0/6 and prompt/reference/runtime diagnostic also passed 0/6. Build an isolated official runtime environment before product use.
